summary: The meeting focused on launch readiness for Friday the 18th, with critical dependencies on checkout and payment approval. Ahmed will complete checkout by Wednesday evening, and Maria will finish product descriptions by Tuesday. Lina will review the payment gateway agreement for Finance approval tomorrow, but approval is not guaranteed due to an open compliance checklist. Analytics tracking will commence after checkout is stable. A vendor sandbox occasionally returns a 401 error, which is noted as a risk but not a launch blocker unless it becomes reproducible. The launch date will not be changed at this time, pending Finance's response.
